serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie.Face.shocked
Lady Annalie: You again?!
You: You don’t have to be so shocked…
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Well, usually I wouldn’t be, but you are here pretty frequently.
Lady Annalie: Let me guess. Are you here for clothes for your girlfriend again?
You: Y-yeah, something like that.
Lady Annalie: The way you are saying it isn’t very convincing…
#Annalie.Face.shocked
Lady Annalie: Don’t tell me…
Lady Annalie: Is some bad lady exploiting your kindness?
You: No! Why would you think that?!
#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: It all makes sense now… {{wi}}Oh poor, poor…
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: …What was your name again?
You: Anon…
#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: Oh poor, poor Anon! You just got bamboozled into buying all these clothes…
Lady Annalie: Have you ever met her? That girlfriend of yours?
You: Of course I have! What are you even implying?
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: W-well, I’m just saying that your girl could have taken advantage of you. 
Lady Annalie: These clothes are not cheap and you were buying them en masse in a short period of time.
Lady Annalie: What I’m saying is, you should check out if she isn’t reselling half of this stuff on ebuy or something.
You: It’s not like that, I can promise you that.
#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: Damn… {{wi}}She has you completely wrapped around her finger…
Ugh…
This is getting annoying.
You: Just stop this, alright?
Lady Annalie: I’m just worrying about your well-being.
You: How can I convince you that she’s not bamboozling me?
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: Actually…{{wi}} There’s a way.{{wi}} Hehehehe…
I have a bad feeling about it.
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: You just need to come here with your girlfriend and then me and her will have a talk. It’s that simple!
I can’t really come here with my bot, that’s just impossible. If people find out that I have a sexbot I’m done for!
You: T-that’s not really a good ide-
Wait a minute… 
While wearing all these clothes I bought, bot looked almost like a real girl…
Maybe not in lingerie and stuff like that, but in some more socially acceptable clothes she could, just maybe, go outside from time to time. This could work!
Lady Annalie: You ok? You went silent for a while.
You: Yeah, sorry about that. 
Lady Annalie: So. Are you coming here with your girl next time? 
You: Let me think about it…
Lady Annalie: Woohoo! He will think about it, he says!
Lady Annalie: You are not saying this only to change the topic, are you?
You: No. It will just require some preparations.
I need to find out what clothes would be best for a camouflage for her.
Lady Annalie: Preparations? The way you said it concerns me in an entirely different way… 
#Annalie.Face.shocked
Lady Annalie: Are you keeping her in your basement against her will?!
You: Of course not! 
#Annalie.Face.normal
You: You really have a vivid imagination…
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: Y-yeah, I know and I’m proud of it!
…
I will leave that without a comment…
#Annalie.Face.normal
You: Alright, let me just go through some clothes now and I’m gone.
Lady Annalie: As you wish.
